title: Solution coordinators read published or rebuilt views
goal: The dashboard keeps working when components stop committing views
acceptance: The coordinator reads the published view at a resolved commit, or builds from the component's sources at that commit with the copied tool
The dashboard names the source commit and which way the view was obtained; fixtures for both
privacy: Tool and procedure text only; fixtures are invented repositories and records; no personal data.
escalation: A view that cannot be obtained is reported, never shown as empty

effort.basis: Estimated 2026-11-24 at agent speed from the coordinator's proposal and its reference implementation. Not a measurement.
